en.title: Anthropic announces "Model Hardware Standard", a common standard that allows AI to operate microscopes and robot arms
en.summary: Anthropic has announced a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a common standard for AI to operate physical equipment such as microscopes and robot arms. By using MHS, it is said that AI will be able to easily handle devices of different manufacturers and types using a common method. read more...

en.title: You can now tag Amazon products on YouTube and earn commission based on sales.
en.summary: YouTube has a feature called "YouTube Shopping" that allows you to tag videos with product information and allow viewers to purchase products directly from there. Furthermore, there is also a ``YouTube Shopping Affiliate Program'' that allows you to receive a portion of product sales as revenue, and it was introduced in Japan in February 2026. It has been announced that Amazon will be joining the YouTube Shopping Affiliate Program as a partner company. This allows you to tag Amazon products on YouTube Shopping. read more...

items.title: 睡眠不足の日に昼寝と同じくらい記憶力を高められる「20分の解決策」とは？
items.summary: 諸事情で普段よりかなり短い時間しか眠れなかったにもかかわらず、どうしても仕事をせざるを得ない日というものがあります。そんな時、昼寝と同じくらい記憶力を向上させられる「20分の解決策」があることが、新たな論文で報告されています。続きを読む...

en.title: What is the ``20 minute solution'' that can improve your memory as much as a nap on days when you are sleep deprived?
en.summary: There are days when I have no choice but to work even though due to various circumstances I was able to sleep much less than usual. A new paper reports that there is a 20-minute solution that can improve your memory as much as a nap. read more...

items.title: OpenAI・Anthropic・GoogleなどがAIによるサイバー攻撃の防御に関する共同声明を発表
items.summary: AIモデルが高性能化するにつれてAIを利用したサイバー攻撃のリスクも高まっていることから、既存のシステムを見直して防御力を高めることが急務とされています。こうした防御力を先端AI企業が率先して提供すべきだとして、OpenAI、Anthropic、Googleなどが共同で声明を発表しました。続きを読む...

en.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others announce joint statement on defending against cyberattacks using AI
en.summary: As AI models become more sophisticated, the risk of AI-based cyber attacks is also increasing, so there is an urgent need to review existing systems and improve their defense capabilities. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others jointly released a statement saying that advanced AI companies should take the lead in providing such defenses. read more...
